note: Gate types stated in the AI-DLC v2.11.5 guide and rule files (kind "aidlc"), plus the studio's Trusted AI gates (kind "studio").

gates.name: Stage approval gate
gates.rule: Every stage your scope runs, outside Initialization, ends with an approval gate. A gate needs a real human message to approve.

gates.name: Assumption Confirmation
gates.rule: Retained assumptions require explicit confirmation before the Product Lead reviewer and approval gate run.

gates.name: Reviewer pass
gates.appliesTo: stages with a reviewer (product lead or architecture reviewer)
gates.rule: Reviewer agents review the stage artifacts and do not produce artifacts; under classic, reviews are advisory: one pass per stage, findings at the approval gate.

gates.name: Practices interview and final gate
gates.rule: Practices interview + final gate. On affirmation, content is promoted to memory/team.md and project.md.

gates.name: Phase verification: Ideation → Inception
gates.rule: Intent captured, scope defined, feasibility confirmed, initiative approved. Written to verification/phase-check-ideation.md.

gates.name: Phase verification: Inception → Construction
gates.rule: All requirements traced to designs, units defined, delivery plan approved. Written to verification/phase-check-inception.md with a pass/fail verdict; if any finding remains, stop the transition and revisit the owning stage.

gates.name: Phase verification: Construction → Operation
gates.rule: All units built and tested, CI pipeline configured, infrastructure designed. If any traceability file is missing or any unresolved finding remains, stop the Construction → Operation transition.

gates.name: Plan Approval (Code Generation)
gates.rule: The person approves the code-generation plan before code is written; infrastructure-as-code is under the same Plan Approval. Never relax, lower, or disable a defined quality target to make a step pass; surface the gap instead.

gates.name: Verified Unit checkpoint
gates.rule: Applies to solo workflows with a real Unit DAG and a stage that produces workspace source: each Unit is approved at a verified Unit checkpoint.

gates.name: Walking skeleton approval
gates.appliesTo: first Unit when skeleton is on
gates.rule: The first Unit must pass a real end-to-end check and the person approves the verified skeleton before later Units begin.

gates.name: Merge gate (team ownership / workshop mode)
gates.rule: The integration lead pins one exact candidate, presents the evidence and pinned OID to a human, and records the merge gate; a rejection keeps the candidate unmerged.

gates.name: Trusted AI checks at each phase's gates
gates.rule: Controls assigned to the phase (studio mapping) are reviewed for owner, status and evidence before the phase's gates are approved.

gates.name: Release decision (go / no-go)
gates.rule: NIST AI RMF MANAGE 1.1: “A determination is made as to whether the AI system achieves its intended purposes and stated objectives and whether its development or deployment should proceed.” Recorded in docs/trusted-ai/release-decision.md by the accountable owner.
